title: Barber & Blade
description: Classic barbershop: bottle green, cream and brass, slab headings and a barber-pole stripe.

tokens.HERO_HEADLINE: A proper haircut, done at a proper pace
tokens.HERO_LEDE: Scissor cuts, fades and straight-razor shaves from three barbers who do not watch the clock.
tokens.ABOUT_TEXT: We opened on Example Street in 2011 with second-hand chairs and one rule: nobody leaves until the neckline is right. The chairs are still here. So is the rule.
tokens.QUOTE: You can tell a good fade from across the street.
tokens.FOOTER_BLURB: A neighbourhood barbershop. Walk-ins welcome before noon.
tokens.HOURS_SHORT: Monday to Saturday, 8 am to 7 pm
tokens.S1_TEXT: Scissor cuts, clipper cuts and skin fades, finished with a razor neckline.
tokens.S2_TEXT: A hot towel, a fresh blade and a cold towel to finish. Allow forty minutes.
tokens.S3_TEXT: Shaped, lined and oiled, alone or with a cut.
tokens.JOURNAL_INTRO: Advice from the chair: upkeep, what to ask for, and how to prepare for a visit.
tokens.SHOP_INTRO: The products on our shelf, for your bathroom. Collect your order at the shop.
